---
title: "Assignment 1: Summary Statistics of Lithic Artifacts"
format: html
---

## Background

You have been given measurements of 150 stone artifacts from four
archaeological sites. Each row of `artifacts.csv` is one artifact:

| Column | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `artifact_id` | Unique artifact label |
| `site` | Site where the artifact was found |
| `raw_material` | Stone type (chert, obsidian, quartzite, basalt) |
| `length_mm`, `width_mm`, `thickness_mm` | Measurements in millimetres |

**How this assignment is graded.** Your results are checked by saving them
under *exact object names*. Each task below tells you which name to use.
Spelling and capitalisation matter. Leave the chunk labels (the name after `r`
in each ` ```{r name} ` line) as they are, because feedback points you to the
chunk to revisit.
You may use base R or `dplyr`, whichever you prefer.

```{r load-data}
artifacts <- read.csv("artifacts.csv")
```

## Task 1: Overall mean and standard deviation of length

Compute the overall mean and the standard deviation of `length_mm` across all
artifacts.

Save the mean as **`mean_length`** and the standard deviation as
**`sd_length`**. Each is a single number.

```{r overall-stats}
mean_length <- mean(artifacts$length_mm)
sd_length <- sd(artifacts$length_mm)
```

## Task 2: Median length by site

Compute the median `length_mm` for each site.

Save the result as **`median_by_site`**, a data frame with two columns named
**`site`** and **`median_length`**, one row per site.

```{r median-by-site}
median_by_site <- artifacts |>
  dplyr::group_by(site) |>
  dplyr::summarise(median_length = median(length_mm)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(median_length))
```

## Task 3: Count of artifacts by raw material

Count how many artifacts are made of each raw material.

Save the result as **`count_by_material`**, a data frame with two columns
named **`raw_material`** and **`n`**, one row per raw material.

```{r count-by-material}
count_by_material <- artifacts |> dplyr::count(raw_material, sort = TRUE)
```

## Task 4: Summary table by site

Build one summary table with a row for each site and these columns, named
exactly as shown:

- **`site`**: the site name
- **`n`**: the number of artifacts
- **`mean_length`**: mean of `length_mm`
- **`sd_length`**: standard deviation of `length_mm`

Save the result as **`summary_table`**, a data frame.

```{r summary-table}
summary_table <- artifacts |>
  dplyr::group_by(site) |>
  dplyr::summarise(n = dplyr::n(), mean_length = mean(length_mm), sd_length = sd(length_mm)) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(mean_length))
```
